scope: Research only. No production changes or asset distribution.

descriptor_experiment.protocol: Intersect regulation.species and feature keys; exclude Mega suffixes and Greninja-Bond, Palafin-Hero, Mimikyu-Busted, Morpeko-Hangry. All base references retained; nonshiny templates with src held out by exact source string. Candidate species score = aggregated appearance distance plus 0.25*max of type-set differences for oracle type arm; no type penalty in appearance-only arm. Ties within 1e-12; strict top1, conservative top3 and reciprocal rank use worst tied position. Base-only balanced arm has exactly one reference per candidate. Fixed coefficients exploratory, no fitting; base provenance and battle independence unknown.

formula.chi2: Replace hue term with 0.7*0.5*sum((p_i-q_i)^2/(p_i+q_i)), zero denominators omitted
formula.circular: Replace hue term by 0.7*sum(abs(cumulative difference - median cumulative difference))/12
formula.source_mean2: Minimum per source string including base as separate pseudo-source; average closest up to two source distances

descriptor_experiment.execution: Connector JavaScript run twice; source code not saved as standalone executable.

pixel_pilot.source_images: Same nine blobs as PV-06, no new asset sources. Connector fetch_file base64; expected Git blob SHA metadata matched for each. Decoded RGBA8 noninterlaced PNG with zlib Adler32 and decoded length validation. No raw assets or feature vectors stored.
pixel_pilot.protocol: Hold query source out. Rank 3 labels by min distance, using either one other source (18 dependent trials) or both other sources (9 queries). No types. Alpha>=128 bounding box, aspect preserved nearest neighbor resize longest side 60 within centered 64x64 canvas, neutral gray fill. Approximate legacy dHash 16x16, hue 24 bins, aspect/density; not exact production extractor. RGB histogram 4 bins/channel, spatial 2x2 concatenated jointly L1-normalized histogram; HOG-like unsigned 9 bins per 16x16 cell with independent L2 normalization (not full Dalal-Triggs overlapping block HOG); mask IoU distance; hybrid equal mean HOG L2/sqrt(32), spatial RGB Hellinger and IoU distance.
pixel_pilot.interpretation: Ceiling effect, no comparative evidence. Three easy posthoc labels and potential common image origins. No actual game screenshot query or 284-class pixel bank; no independent accuracy claim.
pixel_pilot.execution: Connector JS; no standalone decoder/experiment script saved.

conclusion: Hellinger hue metric is priority exploratory alternative: +13/204 appearance-only in augmented bank, +17/204 oracle and +12/204 appearance-only in base-only bank. Oracle augmented top1 tied; macro-label lower than legacy. Mean2 +2/204 oracle but -3/204 appearance. Neither is independently established as superior.
HOG/spatial color/silhouette feasible on existing PNGs, not shown to improve.
No legal full roster/form mapping beyond existing regulation intersection and heuristic exclusions; base image provenance and battle-level holdout remain unresolved.
